Name: Kenneth's Sabbath Letters
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Every Sunday is a day of rest.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]In a game where you can grind 24/7, this mod reminds you to pause. Every Sunday for 7 in-game years (112 Sundays total), you get a calm Sabbath letter with a bible verse and a gentle reminder to take a break, enjoy Pelican Town, and remember God's goodness.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is very slow, very peaceful, and very intentional.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 112 Sabbath Mails - Every Sunday, not every day.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Bible Verses - Psalm 23:1, Matthew 11:28, Philippians 4:13, etc.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Long-term journey - Lasts 7 years, not just Year 1.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Respectful and calm - No preaching, just rest.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example: "Verse for today: 'The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.' - Psalm 23:1 Take a break from the farm today and remember God's goodness. Have a blessed Sabbath!"[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made by Kf - for players who play Stardew with faith and peace.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility - Can I install all your mail mods together?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yes! You can install all of them at the same time, no problem.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- All my mail mods are separate, so they work together.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Want only one vibe? Install just one.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Want a full mailbox every morning? Install them all - you'll get Birthday + Helper + Inspirational + Lore etc. in one day.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- No conflicts, no overwrites, lightweight Content Patcher only.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with Vanilla and Expanded, any farm, any save.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All mail mods by Kf:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Birthday & Gift Guide[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Daily Helper - Useful Mail Every Day[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Inspirational Mails[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Motivational Mails[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Lore Letters[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Sabbath Letters[/b][/size]
